items.title: A new player bar
items.text: Three groups of icons: the picture on the left (upscale, picture size), the film in the middle (back, play, forward, with your seek step written on them), sound and subtitles on the right.

items.title: OpenSubtitles Pro, built in
items.text: More subtitles and none of the spam. Choose in Settings: with AI translations, made by people only, or off.

items.title: Brightness and See in the dark, stronger
items.text: Dark scenes are opened up properly now, and both work on Google TV too, with Clear voice and Even volume.

items.title: Reduce for old TVs
items.text: Google TV: a lighter app for slow devices. On by itself where memory is short, or a switch in Settings, Appearance.
